日: The sun drawn as a box with a line across its middle. One trip of the sun across the sky makes one day.
一: A single flat stroke, like one finger laid down: one.
囗: A square fence closed on all four sides: whatever is drawn inside is enclosed.
王: Three floors of a palace joined by one central pillar: the king rules every floor.
玉: A king with a small dot at his side: the jewel he never lets out of reach.
国: A jewel inside an enclosure: a country guards its treasure within its borders.
人: Two legs striding apart: a person walking, seen from the side.
二: Two flat strokes, a short one over a longer one: two.
厶: A bent arm, elbow jutting out, pulling something close to the chest: this is mine, private.
会: A person spread like a roof over two and an elbow: people squeezed elbow to elbow, meeting under one roof.
十: A cross where two lines meet. Cross your two hands, five fingers each, and you have ten.
干: A cross (ten) with an extra bar on top: a wooden rack where laundry hangs to dry.
年: Like dry, with more bars and a slanted top: drying racks heaped with harvest, filled once a year.
大: A person stretching arms and legs out wide: 'this big!'
木: A tree: a trunk, branches across, and roots spreading at the bottom.
本: A tree with a mark across the base of its trunk: the root, the origin. Books come from trees too.
口: An open mouth seen from the front, squared off.
中: A mouth with a line driven straight through its middle: right in the center.
長: Long hair streaming down from a head, a cane below: the elder with the longest hair is the leader.
山: Three peaks, the middle one tallest: a mountain.
凵: A box with its top open, waiting to be filled.
出: A mountain rising up out of an open box: something pushing up and coming out.
土: A sprout pushing up through a long ground line: soil, earth.
寸: A cross with a dot like a fingertip pressed to a wrist: measuring a tiny span, just a little.
寺: Soil on top of measurement: temple grounds, measured out with care.
時: The sun beside a temple: the temple bell rings as the sun moves, telling the time.
彳: A person in profile with one leg lifting: stepping out, going.
行: Step on the left, a matching stride on the right: two feet going along a crossroads.
礻: A small altar table with an offering on top: it marks gods, shrines and rites.
社: An altar standing on soil: the village shrine where people gather. A company gathers people too.
目: An eye stood upright: a frame with lines across for the lid and pupil.
儿: Two legs walking, with no body above them.
見: A big eye walking around on legs: it goes everywhere to see.
月: A crescent moon with two cloud lines across it. One cycle of the moon is one month.
八: Two strokes spreading apart: eight splits neatly in half, and in half again.
刀: A blade hooked at the tip with a handle slanting off: a sword, a knife.
分: Eight (spreading apart) above a sword: the sword splits things into parts.
幺: A tiny twisted cocoon: a short thread spun into a little knot.
夂: Legs dragging along: walking legs trudging slowly behind.
後: Step, short thread, walking legs: your ankles are tied with a short thread, so you lag behind.
刂: Two upright strokes: a knife standing on its edge, ready to cut.
前: Eight above the moon, a knife at its side: cut through the night to get out in front.
生: A plant sprouting from the ground, leaves branching out: life being born and growing.
五: Two lines (top and bottom) with a zigzag squeezed between them: five.
門: Two swinging doors side by side: a gate.
間: The sun shining through the gap in a gate: a space, an interval between.
卜: A wand with a spark flying off it: divination, reading the future.
上: A magic wand standing up from one line, the ground: pointing above, up.
東: The sun rising behind a tree: east, where the sun comes up.
四: A pair of legs boxed in by an enclosure's four walls: four.
今: A person spread like a roof over one line: duck under it, now!
亠: A dot over a line: a top hat, or a lid sitting on top of something.
立: A top hat on a person whose legs stand firm on a ground line: stand up.
斤: An axe: a short blade at the top, a long handle down the side.
新: Stand a tree up, chop it with an axe: freshly cut wood, brand new.
金: A roof over a mound of soil with two nuggets glinting inside: gold dug from the ground.
乙: One twisting stroke like a fishhook or a swan's neck: second in line, the latter.
九: The latter's fishhook with an arm bent across it: nine, reaching for ten but not quite.
入: Like person, but the right stroke leans in on top: someone ducking head-first to enter.
手: A hand: a wrist line running down, with fingers branching out across it.
⺍: Three little dots raining down on top, like sparkles.
冖: A cloth draped over the top: covering whatever is below.
子: A swaddled baby: a big head, arms stretched out, legs wrapped together.
学: Three dots of light over a cover over a child: a child under the school roof, ideas sparkling above.
冂: A box turned upside down: a frame, like a doorway.
高: A top hat, a mouth, a frame with another mouth inside: floors stacked up into a tall tower.
円: A frame with a line across inside: a coin purse holding round yen coins.
夕: A crescent moon only half drawn: early evening, when the moon first appears.
外: Evening plus a magic wand: fortune-tellers do their divining outside, under the evening sky.
言: Lines of words pouring out above a mouth: to say.
六: A top hat over eight: the hat swallows two of the eight. Six.
下: A magic wand hanging down from one line, the ceiling: below, down.
米: A rice plant: grains scattered in every direction from a cross.
来: Rice with an extra bar on top: a cart loaded with rice comes into town.
气: Wisps of steam rising in layered lines, curling away at the end.
気: Steam with an X inside: invisible air, the energy you can feel but not see.
小: One short line with a little dot falling off each side: small.
七: One line cut by the latter's hook bending right: turn it upside down and it looks like a 7.
千: Ten with an extra slash on top: tally up ten, add a slash, and you jump to a thousand.
舌: A thousand over a mouth: the tongue tastes a thousand flavors in your mouth.
話: Say plus tongue: words rolling off your tongue as you talk.
多: Evening stacked on evening: many, many evenings piled up.
宀: A roof with a chimney dot on top.
女: A woman kneeling gracefully, arms crossed in front.
安: A woman under a roof: home safe, relaxed, at peace.
匕: A spoon lying on its side, ready to scoop.
北: Two figures sitting back to back, a spoon on the right: turning their backs to the cold north wind.
午: Dry with a slanted top: a sundial post at noon, when the midday sun dries everything.
白: The sun with a ray shooting off the top: shining white.
百: One over white: by age one hundred, all your hair is white.
聿: A hand gripping a writing brush straight down the middle.
書: A brush over the day: writing in your diary every day.
先: Legs below, a head pushing forward on top: the runner out ahead, the one who goes first.
名: Evening plus mouth: in the dark evening you call out your name so people know who you are.
川: Three lines of water flowing downhill: a river.
自: An eye with a tick on top: a nose. In Japan you point at your nose to mean 'me, oneself.'
首: Hair sticking up over oneself, the face: the whole head, sitting on its neck.
⻌: A road with a wavy path sweeping along the bottom, carrying you forward.
道: A neck and head moving along the road: your head leads you down the way.
水: A central stream with splashes flying off both sides: water.
半: A cross (ten) with an extra bar, its top split into two horns: cut down the middle, in half.
田: A rice field seen from above, split into four paddies.
力: A flexed arm, bicep bulging: power, strength.
男: A rice field over power: the man putting his strength into the field.
西: A lid over a box with legs inside: a bird tucking into its nest as the sun sets in the west.
雨: The sky on top, a cloud frame below with raindrops falling inside: rain.
電: Rain above, a day below with a tail zapping down: lightning from a stormy sky, electricity.
少: Little with a stroke slicing off below: something small gets even fewer.
父: Two sweat drops over crossed tools: father hard at work.
交: A top hat over father: dad in his top hat, legs crossed, mingling at the party.
校: A tree plus mingle: kids mingling under the tree in the schoolyard.
語: Say, five, mouth: five mouths saying words, a whole language.
穴: A roof over eight (spreading apart): the roof has split open, leaving a hole.
工: An I-beam: the tool and material of craft and construction.
空: A hole above craft: the builder looks up through the hole in the roof at the empty sky.
耳: An ear: the outer rim with folds inside.
聞: An ear pressed to the gate: listening to hear what's said inside.
食: A roof over a heaped bowl of rice: everyone sits down together to eat.
車: A cart seen from above: a box body with an axle through it, a wheel on each end.
亻: A person squeezed thin, standing at the side.
丁: One line with a nail driven down from it: a T-shaped street junction.
可: A mouth tucked under a street sign: it says 'yes, you can pass.'
何: A person beside can: 'Can I ask... what?'
南: Ten on top of a frame with dry inside: a hot frame where everything dries under the southern sun.
足: A mouth-shaped kneecap on top, a leg striding out below: the leg and foot.
万: One line with a flag snapping below it: the banner waved over ten thousand soldiers.
广: A cliff with a dot on top: a lean-to canopy, like a shop awning.
占: A magic wand over a mouth: the fortune-teller speaks your future.
店: A canopy over a fortune-teller: her little shop under an awning, a store.
𠂉: A short stroke leaning on a longer one: a person reclining, propped up on one elbow, wearing a little hat.
毋: A mother's frame with one stroke straight through it: a mother barring the way and saying do not.
毎: A hat over a woman-like shape with two dots inside, a mother: every time she goes out, the hat goes on.
古: Ten over a mouth: a story passed through ten mouths is old.
天: One line above large: even the biggest person has the heavens above him.
罒: A net stretched sideways, like an eye on its side: a mesh to catch things.
貝: An eye with eight below: a shellfish peeking out, little feet poking from its shell.
買: A net over a shellfish (shells were once money): scoop up money in your net to buy things.
士: Like soil, but the top line is longer: a samurai standing tall, shoulders broad.
吉: A gentleman over a mouth: the samurai's words bring good luck.
周: A frame wrapped around good luck: walk all the way around it, a full circuit.
週: A circuit along the road: one full lap of seven days, a week.
母: Like a woman with two dots inside: a mother nursing her baby.
火: Flames leaping up, sparks flying out on each side: fire.
艹: Little blades of grass sprouting up on top.
化: A person beside a spoon: stir the pot and everything changes into something new.
花: Grass that changes: a green bud changes into a flower.
右: A hand reaching down to a mouth: the right hand that feeds you.
売: A gentleman over a covered stall on legs: a merchant walking his cart, calling out to sell.
読: Say plus sell: the merchant reads his list out loud to sell.
又: A grabbing hand: it reaches out again, and again.
友: A hand reaching out to another hand: friends holding hands again and again.
左: A hand over craft: the left hand holds the tool steady while the right does the work.
休: A person leaning against a tree: resting.
灬: Four sparks of flame at the bottom: fire burning below.
馬: A horse: mane flying on top, four legs (fire) galloping below.
尸: A body bent over, slumped flat: a corpse.
尺: A body with a leg stretched out: measuring the floor with your stride, foot by foot.
駅: A horse beside measure: the old post station where tired horses were swapped at set distances.
飠: Food squeezed to the side: a roof over a bowl of rice.
欠: A person yawning, mouth wide open: lacking sleep.
飲: Food beside a wide-open yawning mouth: gulping down a drink.
魚: A fish: a pointed head, a rice-field body of scales, and fire for the flicking tail.
同: A frame with one mouth inside: everyone in the room speaks with one mouth, the same.
⺕: A hand gripping a broom: three bristle lines on a handle.
事: A mouth on top, a broom-hand gripping a long pole: a busy worker shouting about the matter at hand.
氏: A stooped figure with a hook beside it: the clan elder who carries the family name.
民: Family name under a box: families gathered under one roof make up a people, a nation.
癶: Two feet planted apart like a tent: getting ready to set out on footsteps.
発: Footsteps above two and legs: legs taking their first steps out the door. Departure!
耂: An old man bending over his cane: the top of old.
者: Old over day: an old someone sitting in the sun all day.
地: Soil beside the latter's twisting stroke: a worm wriggling through the ground.
合: A person-shaped lid over one line and a mouth: the lid fits snugly onto the pot.
巾: A cloth hanging from a rod: a towel.
市: A top hat over a towel: a market stall selling hats and towels.
羊: A sheep's head: two horns on top and a woolly body.
業: Busy strokes piled on a sheep on a tree: so much work going on, business is booming.
方: A top hat over an arm swinging out: pointing which direction to go.
回: A mouth inside an enclosure: going round and round in circles.
旦: The sun just above the horizon line: daybreak.
勿: A hand waving a flag with streamers: flapping it to say 'no, you must not!'
場: Soil beside daybreak, rays streaming below: the place on the ground where morning sun lands.
員: A mouth over a shellfish (money): the member who gets paid to talk.
開: A gate with dry inside: throw the gate open so the wet things inside can dry.
問: A mouth at the gate: asking questions at the door.
弋: An arrow with a string tied on, ready to shoot.
代: A person beside shoot (arrow): when one archer falls, a substitute steps in.
明: Sun plus moon: the two brightest lights in the sky.
里: A rice field on soil: farmland and ground, your home village.
重: A thousand on top of a village: carrying a thousand loads through the village is heavy.
動: Heavy plus power: use your power to move something heavy.
京: A top hat and a mouth on little pillars: tall buildings rising in the capital.
用: A frame with crossed bars inside: a handy rack you can use for anything.
通: Use the road: commuters pass through it every day.
理: King plus village: the king runs the village with logic and reason.
体: A person plus origin: your body is where a person begins.
主: A king with a dot on top like a crown jewel: the lord, the master in charge.
疋: A foot taking a step, toes at the bottom.
是: The sun over a foot: sun right overhead, foot placed just so. Right.
頁: A head on legs, a big head; it also means a page.
題: Just so plus head: the heading, the topic written at the top of the page.
音: Stand above day: someone standing up at sunrise to make a sound, a morning song.
心: Four strokes like the chambers of a beating heart.
意: Sound over heart: the sound of your heart is your mind, your idea.
不: A line blocking a sprout from growing up: no, not.
作: A person beside a ladder of lines: someone building, making something step by step.
廿: Two tens joined at the bottom: twenty.
度: A hand under a canopy counting to twenty: tally every time, degree by degree.
弓: A bow, bent and ready, the string curving.
虫: In the middle with a tail: a bug with a round body and a little tail.
強: A bow, an elbow, an insect: an insect drawing a bow with its elbow. So strong!
扌: A hand pressed to the side: fingers across, the thumb hooking down.
持: A hand beside a temple: holding the temple's offerings in your hand.
了: Like child with no arms: the baby is wrapped up tight, finished, complete.
予: Complete with an extra arm reaching out: get everything ready beforehand.
野: Village plus beforehand: the open fields outside the village, cleared beforehand.
⻏: A village banner flying on the right, shaped like a big ear.
都: Someone plus village: so many someones in one village it becomes a metropolis.
以: A person beside a dot and a hook: by means of the tool in hand, he gets it done.
思: A rice field over a heart: the farmer thinking about his fields.
豕: A pig with short legs and a sagging belly.
家: A pig under a roof: a home where the family pig lives too.
世: Looks like three tens joined: about thirty years, one generation of the world.
匸: A box open on the right: a hiding place, tucked away.
区: An X inside a hiding enclosure: the city split up and marked into wards.
県: An eye over little: the governor keeps an eye on every little town in the prefecture.
隹: A small bird with a stubby tail, feathers in rows.
進: A bird hopping along the road, always forward: advance.
止: A magic wand planted on the ground with a foot beside it: stop right here.
正: One line on top of stop: stop exactly at the line. Correct.
⻖: A hill on the left side, with steps for climbing.
元: Two above legs: a toddler's first two steps, the beginning.
完: A roof over the beginning: once the roof is on, the house is complete.
院: Hill plus perfect: a perfect building up on the hill, a temple or institution.
介: A person standing over two posts, stuck in between them: jammed in.
界: A rice field with something jammed in between: the boundary line between plots.
厂: A cliff face with an overhanging ledge.
産: Stand up under a cliff, new life: giving birth in the shelter of a cliff.
孝: Old above child: a child carrying an old parent. Filial piety.
攵: A hand holding a stick, ready to strike.
教: Filial piety plus a taskmaster's strike: the strict teacher with a stick.
文: A top hat on crossed legs: a scholar sitting cross-legged, writing sentences.
近: An axe on the road: the woodcutter is near, you can hear him chopping.
考: Old with a bent line below: the old man bent over his cane, thinking it over.
由: A field with a sprout poking out the top: the seed is the reason it grew.
画: One line on top, a field in an open box: a picture frame around a painted field.
氵: Three drops of water splashing on the side.
海: Water everywhere: water plus every is the sea.
矢: An arrow: feathered tip on top, shot up into the heavens.
知: Arrow plus mouth: you answer as fast as an arrow, so you know it.
集: Birds on a tree: birds gather together in the branches.
勹: An arm curling around to wrap something up.
別: A mouth, a wrap and a knife: cut the wrapping apart to separate it.
牛: A cow's head with horns, seen from the front.
物: A cow beside a waving flag: the market waves flags over cows and other things for sale.
引: A bow with a line beside it: pull the string back.
丈: One line with crossed strokes: a hand gripping a measuring stick for length.
吏: Length over a mouth: the official who measures out orders with his mouth.
使: A person plus officer: the officer uses a person as his messenger.
戸: One line over a frame: a single sliding door.
所: A door with an axe beside it: the woodcutter's place.
品: Three mouths stacked up: lots of boxes of goods piled high.
計: Say ten: counting aloud to ten as you measure and plan.
歹: Bones lying under a line: the bare bones of death.
死: Bones beside a spoon dropped from a still hand: death.
特: A cow at the temple: a special, sacred cow.
禾: A tree whose top droops: grain heavy with ripe heads.
私: Grain plus elbow: hugging your grain with your elbow. It's mine, private.
台: An elbow resting on a mouth-shaped box: leaning on a stand, a pedestal.
始: A woman on a pedestal: she steps up and the show begins.
早: The sun over ten: up and shining before ten o'clock. Early!
朝: Ten, early, moon: the sun is up early while the moon still shows. Morning.
村: A tree plus measurement: a village marked out by its trees.
軍: A cover over a car: tanks under camouflage, the army.
運: The army on the road: carrying supplies and hoping for luck.
糸: A twisted skein of thread with loose ends hanging below.
冫: Two drops of water frozen in place: ice.
冬: Walking legs over ice: trudging through ice in winter.
終: Thread plus winter: the year's thread runs out in winter. The end.
広: A canopy with an elbow under it: a canopy wide enough to stretch your elbows.
住: A person beside the lord: the person lives on the lord's land.
具: An eye over a table on two legs: tools laid out to be inspected.
真: Ten eyes inspecting a tool: true, really true.
有: A hand holding the moon: you have it, you own it.
町: A rice field beside a street: a town.
斗: A ladle with two drops in its scoop: the dipper.
料: Rice plus dipper: measuring out rice with a dipper to pay the fee.
廴: A long sweeping stride across the bottom.
建: A brush with a long stride: the architect's brush sweeping out plans to build.
急: A hand with a broom over a heart: your heart races as you hurry to sweep.
送: Heavens on the road: sending your friend off down the road under the open sky.
切: Seven plus a sword: seven slashes of the sword cut it to pieces.
兄: A big mouth on legs: the big brother who walks around talking.
説: Say, eight, elder brother: big brother explains things at great length.
転: A car with two and an elbow: elbow grease turns the wheels, round and round.
石: A rock tumbled under a cliff edge: a stone.
研: Stone plus dry: rub a dry stone to polish and sharpen.
究: A hole plus nine: dig into nine holes to research.
楽: A white drum on a wooden stand, ice-like bells on each side: music and fun.
走: Soil over a striding foot: running on the ground.
己: A coiled line, like a snake curled up: oneself, wrapped up in yourself.
起: Run plus self: get yourself up and running.
着: A sheep over an eye: pulling a wool sweater down over your eyes to wear it.
乗: A thousand on a tree: someone riding high, perched in the branches.
疒: A sickbed with drops of sweat on the side.
内: A person in a frame: inside.
丙: One lid over inside: the third drawer down, third class.
病: Sickness plus third class: when ill, you feel third-rate.
声: A gentleman over a door shape: his voice carries right through the door.
質: Two axes over a shellfish (money): good quality costs money.
待: Step plus temple: step to the temple and wait.
式: Shoot plus craft: the arrow-shooting ceremony, done in proper style.
試: Say the ceremony: test what you learned by saying it aloud.
族: A direction flag with arrows below: a tribe gathered under its banner.
艮: An eye with legs dug in: a root, stopped still.
銀: Gold plus root: silver, one root below gold.
央: Large in a frame: a person standing in the center.
映: Day plus center: the sun at the center reflects off the water.
親: Stand on a tree and see: parents climb a tree to watch for their children.
験: A horse beside a person with a mouth: testing a horse before buying, checking its mouth and teeth.
働: A person who moves: a person on the move is at work.
好: Woman plus child: a mother is fond of her child.
英: Grass with a center: the hero standing in the center of the flower field.
豆: A mouth on a stand: a bowl of beans on a stand.
頭: Beans plus head: your bean-shaped head.
低: A person, family name, one: a person bowing low, close to the line.
医: An arrow in a hiding enclosure: the doctor puts away the arrow he removed.
仕: A person beside a gentleman: serving the samurai.
去: Soil plus elbow: the elbow pushes off the ground to leave.
未: A tree with its top branch shorter than the one below: it has not yet grown tall.
味: Mouth plus not yet: taste fruit that's not yet ripe.
与: A hooked arm and a line: bestowing a gift.
写: A cover over bestow: put a cover over the page to copy.
字: A roof over a child: the child learns characters at home.
竹: Two bamboo stalks with leaves hanging down.
答: Bamboo over fit: bamboo strips that fit together, the answer.
夜: A top hat, a person, evening: someone in a top hat out late in the night.
注: Water plus lord: pour the master's tea.
帰: A knife, a broom, a cover and a towel: come home and clean up.
歌: Can over can beside a wide-open mouth: someone singing, mouth open wide.
⺌: Three little strokes on top: small.
光: Small on top, one line, legs: light rays sparkling above a person.
亜: Two lines squeezing a mouth in the middle: squeezed into second place, next in rank.
悪: A heart crushed under a heavy frame: a crushed heart turns bad.
図: An enclosure with three dots and marks inside: a map with markings.
至: An elbow over soil: crawl on your elbows across the ground until you reach the goal.
室: A roof over reach: you reach your room.
太: Large with a dot: a large person with a belly. Plump.
歩: Stop over few: stop a few times as you walk.
几: Two legs under a flat top: a low little table, or the frame a sail is stretched across.
風: A bug blown inside a billowing sail: the wind.
紙: Thread plus family name: the family name written on paper made of threads.
黒: Village over fire: smoke from the fire blackens the village.
春: Three, large, sun: three big sunny days. Spring.
赤: Soil over flames: the ground glowing red.
青: Life over the moon: fresh green life growing under a blue moonlit sky.
官: A roof over two mouths stacked: officials under one roof talking.
館: Food plus bureaucrat: the big building where officials eat.
屋: A body that has reached shelter: lie down at last under a roof. A house.
色: A face over a coiled self: blushing, your color changes.
